info.name: Hotel Booking API
info.description:
Tests every endpoint of the Hotel Booking API. Run the whole collection in order (Runner → Run).

Before running: open this collection → Variables tab and set the **Current value** of `adminPassword` (and `adminEmail` if it is not admin@example.com) to the account created by `npm run seed:admin`, then press Ctrl+S. No environment is needed; the optional "Hotel Booking API - Local" environment only overrides `baseUrl`.

- Each run registers two new users with unique emails and creates its own hotel, so it can be re-run against the same database.
- Requests ending in (400), (401), (403) or (404) are deliberate failure cases.
- Requests send the token as `Authorization: Bearer`; cookies are disabled so 401/403 checks are real.
- Every request also checks the 3-second response time requirement.

// NFR: every request must complete within 3 seconds.
